title: Pudding Oats Vanilla Blueberry
description: Thick, creamy oats made with vanilla pudding powder and skyr — eat warm or refrigerate overnight for a mousse-like texture.
steps: Add oats, water, sweetener and a pinch of salt to a pot. Heat on medium, stirring occasionally for 2 minutes until thick.
Mix pudding powder and milk in a glass until smooth (no lumps).
Pour pudding mix into oats; stir 1 minute until thick again.
Transfer to a bowl; mix in skyr. Top with blueberries.
notes: Cover with plastic wrap touching the surface before refrigerating to prevent a skin forming. Add 15g casein + 50g water on top for more protein (+55 kcal, +11g protein).
